author: Scott Manley
description:
Ready to be seen? Check that appointment off your to-do list with Zocdoc:
https://zocdoc.com/scottmanley #sponsored 

In 2020 I made a video covering every version of China's Long March rocket, now I look back over the last 6 years and see a massive expansion in the population of rockets being being in China, and most of the new designs are funded by private capital, with wealthy Chinese investors hoping to create China's version of SpaceX

title: China Has More Rocket Designs Than Anyone Else.....
